intake.author_task: Capture only user-confirmed goals, constraints, budget, compute, schedule, application routes, exclusions and ethical boundaries. Leave unknown material facts explicit. Do not approve or advance the gate.

topic-intelligence.author_task: Research at least three serious topic candidates using current primary sources. Preserve search queries, inclusion and rejection reasons, uncertainty, negative evidence, the core thesis A and independent extension B. Do not claim novelty from absence alone.

paper-architecture.author_task: Build the complete paper map and one testable contract per configured paper. Give every paper a distinct question, falsification condition, dependencies, shared assets and fallback venues; reject salami slicing.

experiment-design.author_task: Produce licensed dataset manifests, a machine-executable experiment plan and hard budget. Pre-register hypotheses, splits, leakage controls, baselines, ablations, metrics, seeds, uncertainty, stopping rules and negative-result handling. Never confirm a license for the human.

experiment-execution.author_task: Execute only the exact G3-approved plan through scripts/experiment_runner.py. Preserve failed attempts, immutable configuration, output hashes and negative results. Build the claim-evidence matrix and reproducibility report without selecting favorable runs.

writing-and-review.author_task: Work only on state.active_paper. Write from the claim-evidence matrix, run citation and venue compliance audits, preserve two review rounds and itemized responses, and complete disclosure records. Never invent citations, results, authorship or venue status, and never submit.
